pages.title: Custom Loading Video
pages.text: $(warn)Requires NarutoLoading.$()$(br2)Bored of the default loading screen? While you're on the main menu (not inside a world), drag any video file into the Minecraft window to use it as the new loading screen background.$(br2)The change takes effect immediately — no restart needed!

pages.title: When Does This Work?
pages.text: This only triggers when you are $(bold)not currently in a world$() — for example, on the main menu or a server select screen.$(br2)$(note)If you're already inside a world, dragging a video will instead try to set a video cape or create a video screen — not change the loading screen.$()

pages.title: What Happens
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Your video file is copied into the NarutoLoading folder automatically. The original file is left untouched.$(br2)$(bold)2.$() NarutoLoading is updated to use your new video as the background.$(br2)$(bold)3.$() The loading screen restarts with your video playing right away.

pages.title: Good to Know
pages.text: • Each new drop $(bold)replaces$() the previous loading video.$(br)• Dropping the same file again won't create duplicate copies.$(br2)$(note)This handler never blocks other drop actions — so if you drop a video on the main menu, DragIt will also check if other drop triggers apply at the same time.$()
